name: Shyopot
source:
Two months ago, Egor and Fedya went into the abandoned Shelman psychiatric hospital one night and never came back. The search was called off long ago, but their friends can't let go. On an old urban-legends forum they find posts by a former orderly about underground floors, a head doctor who forbade anyone to go down after six in the evening, and patients who were never found.

Six friends decide to go down there themselves.

https://deksyyy.itch.io/whisper
